lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I have something to ask you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Do you like perfume too?
Yeah, I do.
Hmm, not really.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Why?
No particular reason. I just like it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Tch, how boring.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Just as I suspected.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Isn't the point of perfume to mask unpleasant smells?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: But Nikkes don't have any body odor.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So there's no real need for it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Despite that, why...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: does Emma obsess over fragrances so much?
Hmm, isn't it nice when something smells good?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The idea of a "pleasant smell" is vague from the start.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It might be pleasant to Emma,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: but it's definitely not to me.
Have you tried telling Emma that?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Of course I have.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And as soon as I told her,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: she said, "Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I guess I'll have to get a different scent ready then!"

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Right now, there are already over 20 bottles of perfume

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: piled up in my room.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Even if I keep them sealed in the box, the smell still seeps out.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: This is a problem I just can't solve on my own anymore.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So you fix it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Can't you read? I said you fix it.
Me? How?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Figure something out somehow.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're good at sweet-talking Nikkes with that silver tongue of yours,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: so put that skill to good use

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: on Emma too.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: She's going to be here in 30 mins with another scent.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That means you need to be here in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Come straight to my room.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hurry up, I'll be waiting.
Wait a sec... Eunhwa?
There's no reply from Eunhwa...
Looks like I'll have to go check it out myself.
